definitions.primary: mean squared error of six continuous fields / common train std
definitions.scaler: union of training current/next states, population std, floor .001
definitions.phase: contact if either endpoint contact; else approach if current y < .25; else flight
definitions.rollout_feedback: contacts >= .5; no state refresh or ground snapping
definitions.rollout_anchor_rule: first stored anchor per behavior-reference phase in each of first 8 sorted test episodes
definitions.distribution_contexts: first 16 sorted test episodes with >=64 reference records, equal context weight
definitions.distribution_samples: up to 512 records per context, fixed random subset
definitions.distribution_radius: 95th percentile reference leave-one-out nearest neighbor distance
definitions.action_pairs: all six unordered command pairs per four-action anchor, coupled simulator RNG
